constitutional_basis: Article XXXV — closed-loop epistemic control. The hydraulic architecture is the 'mechanistic simulator' input slot of the loop.

topology.per_segment: Independent variable-orifice valve + pressure sensor + flow sensor
topology.common_node_proximal: Single proximal catheter into ventricle (CSF source)
topology.common_node_distal: Single distal catheter into peritoneum (CSF sink)
topology.communication: Wired (intracorporeal bus) for V1 implantable; wireless for V0 bench

physics_model.INV_2_translation: For each active i: alpha_i * G_HEALTHY * P_ICP <= F_MAX

design_limit_identified_by_simulator.finding: Strict dual-invariant (P_ICP<=20 AND F<=F_MAX) FAILS at peak ~22 mmHg under multi-segment progressive failure
design_limit_identified_by_simulator.root_cause: Dual-invariant conflict: at high P_ICP, INV-2 cap forces alpha down, preventing the controller from opening valves enough to drive P_ICP back below 20 mmHg
design_limit_identified_by_simulator.controller_policy: When conflict, preserve INV-2 (no path overload, no localized tissue damage) at the cost of mild INV-1 violation (P_ICP up to ~22 mmHg, still far below catastrophic >40)
design_limit_identified_by_simulator.honest_claim: GRACEFUL DEGRADATION under progressive failure, not strict dual-invariant maintenance
design_limit_identified_by_simulator.next_design_iteration: Increase F_MAX_PER_SEG OR n_segments OR add accumulator buffer to push the conflict boundary
